```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
```


read in data and merge metaphlan results to create merged taxonomy file
```{r}
barcodes <- read.csv("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/bewell_barcodes.csv")

fq.df <- as.data.frame(list.files("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/profiled")) 

fq.df <- fq.df %>%
  mutate(sampnames = substr(fq.df$`list.files("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/profiled")`, 10, 19))

mettab.ls <- lapply(fq.df$sampnames, function(x) read.table(paste0("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/profiled/profiled_", x, ".txt"),
                                                            header = F, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = F))

names(mettab.ls) <- fq.df$sampnames

ID <- fq.df$sampnames

mettab.ls <- mapply(function(x,y) "[<-"(x, "sample", value = y),
               mettab.ls, ID, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

mettab.ls <- mettab.ls[-63]

metab.df <- bind_rows(lapply(fq.df$sampnames, function(x) mettab.ls[[x]]))

metab.df.form <- metab.df %>%
  dplyr::rename("Taxonomy" = "V1",
         "TaxNum" = "V2",
         "RelAbun" = "V3",
         "Alternative.Tax" = "V4")




df <- merge(barcodes, metab.df.form)
df$id <- as.character(df$id)
```

add timepoint value
```{r}
subs <- read_csv("/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/mimic_subjects.csv")

keep <- melt(subs, id.vars=1:3) %>%
  dplyr::rename("id" = value)

df <- merge(keep, df)
```

save table
```{r}
write.csv(df,"/fs/ess/PAS1695/projects/bewell/data/bewell_taxonomy_relAbun.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
